tasks.label: Compile Sass (style + editor)
tasks.command: npx --yes sass sass/style.scss css/style.css --style=expanded && npx --yes sass sass/style.scss css/style.min.css --style=compressed && npx --yes sass sass/editor-style.scss css/editor-style.css --style=expanded && npx --yes sass sass/editor-style.scss css/editor-style.min.css --style=compressed
